g.text: C4 · affine elliptic waves and a free lattice curve
Panels 1–5: a₂ = 1, a₀₀ = 0; a₀ varies. Panel 6: one fixed Lax equation, with β free. Diamonds mark Δ = 0.
The explorer lets you edit all six equation coefficients, select the sweep coordinate, focus a branch, and inspect its profile. Only the affine-℘ sector is shown.
